model: resnet18, ImageNet pretrained (IMAGENET1K_V1), new 4-class output layer
loss: cross-entropy with label smoothing 0.1 for training, plain cross-entropy for reporting
optimiser: AdamW, no weight decay on biases and BatchNorm
augmentation:
on the fly, training images only: Compose(
    RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.5)
    RandomApply(
    p=0.8
    RandomRotation(degrees=[-20.0, 20.0], interpolation=nearest, expand=False, fill=0)
)
    RandomApply(
    p=0.8
    ColorJitter(brightness=(0.7, 1.3), contrast=(0.7, 1.3), saturation=(0.7, 1.3), hue=(-0.05, 0.05))
)
    RandomApply(
    p=0.5
    RandomAffine(degrees=[0.0, 0.0], translate=(0.03, 0.03))
)
    RandomApply(
    p=0.2
    GaussianBlur(kernel_size=(3, 3), sigma=(0.1, 1.0))
)
)
